title: Star Wars Jedi Fallen Order Dark Temple #4 #5 Lot Marvel 2019 Cere Junda Finale
conditionDescription: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Star Wars: Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple #4 and #5 (2019-2020), Marvel Comics - the final two issues of the 5-part prequel to the Respawn video game, starring Jedi Cere Junda. Matthew Rosenberg, Paolo Villanelli, Arif Prianto. $3.99 cover price each.

- #4: Cere vs. the temple guardians cover; back cover Avengers: Endgame soundtrack ad
- #5: final issue

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
